name: silvershop/address-lookup-postnl
description: PostNL Adrescheck provider for silvershop/address-lookup (CMS 6): a satellite connector that resolves NL addresses structurally (postcode + house number -> street + city via PostNL's Dutch addresscheck) and every other country via free-text international autocomplete, over PostNL's unified Adrescheck Autocomplete (ACI) API. Authenticates with an `apikey` header (SS_POSTNL_API_KEY) and is inert without a key. Registers the `postnl` provider; carrier-aligned for shops shipping with PostNL/MyParcel.

suggest.silvershop/shipping-myparcel: Pairs well: a shop shipping NL/BE parcels via PostNL/MyParcel gets carrier-aligned address data from the same courier.
